title: fix(clone): the focus-unrecognized hint names every measured cause and only prescribes a teardown where it cures
description:
follow-up to ehmpathy/rhachet#655 (fulcrum F1 of .behavior/v2026_11_08.fix-clone-say-labeled-rule, ruled out of that nano fix by the wisher).

the focus-unrecognized hint in src/domain.operations/clone/socket/computeCloneSayReport.ts claims both measured causes are permanent and prescribes a teardown of the clone. #655 proved a third cause: a box rule shape the classifier does not recognize, which a teardown does not cure.

the copy should: drop the claim of permanence; name the read (clone get --debug); list the measured causes (a 0x0 geometry, a detached host, an unrecognized box rule shape); and say a teardown clears only the first two. the target timeline is in 1.vision.experience.case=3.box-still-unfound.md of that route.
